Горн сам выкладывает **клинки** на наков:
The forge lays **blades** on the anvil by itself. Drag a blade onto the same one and you get one a level higher and much stronger. A double tap merges a blade with the nearest twin. A blade of another level swaps places, and the **sale chest** takes one for gold.

All blades cut the monster at the gate by themselves, each one drops **gold**. Every tenth wave is a **boss** with a timer: miss it and you fall back a wave and farm until you press «Try again». A tap on the forge speeds up the current blade.

With a record of wave 60 the **reforge** opens: everything goes into the fire, **coals** stay — each gives +5 % damage and gold forever, and coals buy the **Master's Forge**. Coals pay only for a better record. After 1 000 coals **Star metal** opens.

Горн сам выкладывает **клинки** на наков:
The forge lays **blades** on the anvil by itself. Drag a blade onto the same one and you get one a level higher and much stronger. A double tap merges a blade with the nearest twin. A blade of another level swaps places, and the **sale chest** takes one for gold.

All blades cut the monster at the gate by themselves, each one drops **gold**. Every tenth wave is a **boss** with a timer: miss it and you fall back a wave and farm until you press «Try again». A tap on the forge speeds up the current blade.

With a record of wave 60 the **reforge** opens: everything goes into the fire, **coals** stay — each gives +5 % damage and gold forever, and coals buy the **Master's Forge**. Coals pay only for a better record. After 1 000 coals **Star metal** opens.

When the anvil is full, keep tapping: new blades without a free slot are sold at the normal price. Blades on the field and queued chest rewards are kept.

**Outpost:** after the first boss, recruit Bran or Veya and give them a real blade from the anvil. Pets and tempering unlock at wave 20; the dragon at wave 30. Prepare an ability, aim or occasionally intercept the approaching monster.

Reforging keeps heroes, XP, pets and absorbed dragon power. Weapons, tempers, the rack and undigested blades reset with the run. Anvil Memory also considers equipped weapons.

**Progression:** choose talents at hero ranks 3, 6 and 10. Eira and the raven unlock at record wave 40; Corvin and the turtle at 50. An adult dragon gains breath forms; molting requires a new record and spends absorbed power while keeping its age.

**Requests:** contracts unlock at wave 25, branching expeditions at 45 and separate forge trials at 60. Awarded mentor XP can train a recruited hero. Delivered blades are consumed at the quoted value. Trials use a separate board and never spend your real weapons.
